open_items: MONEY CENTS: the kit keeps Gate B's [D20] rule unchanged (brief §5.2), which gives block-A needs $94.23 / $81.48 / $77.23, not the brief's $94.22 / $81.49 / $77.25. The brief rounded each pod's spend to $10.48 before summing (giving 81.49 and 77.25) and applied 1.25 to the unrounded $75.375 (giving 94.22); a test shows both. Differences are at most $0.02; the lead decides whether to keep [D20] (kit) or change the rule.

DEAL RULE: Q3's example order (seed-major round robin) puts A1@1102 and A1@1103 on one pod under plan B's block A (14 runs, 4 pods), so the kit deals arm-major, seed-minor, run i to pod i mod P; with P >= 3 no pod holds one arm twice, and the deal refuses otherwise. The lead should confirm this fixed rule before launch.

FUNDING GROUPS: the user's rule names blocks (block A first). The kit funds S1-0 and the certificate pod from block A's funding record, and B10's certification pod from block B's (rules.FUNDING_BLOCK). Each init's need is CONTINGENCY x the worst path over every part of its group planned so far plus this part, which is conservative. One record may serve several parts of a group. Lead or user to confirm.

UNMEASURED ESTIMATES (flagged in job records): O500 under Branch 128 = 1,024 s (I: 1,517 x 27/40); rep_pass 1 h and l1_scan 1 h (I; the brief gives no number); REF_FORWARD_SHARE 0.5 for B+Qi (I); Safe LoRA hashing/V-check 600 s (I); cert_c3 0.5 h (I); POD_SIZES disk 80/40 GB (I, for the base model). The pod's preflight must supply o500_s in its cap_projection so the gate uses max(plan, projection).

c0 on Y: the kit lets c0 run on engine Y on the cert pod before the certificate is recorded (REV4 §10.3 puts c0 on C1's pod). This widens G4's stated exceptions (C1-C3 and B+Qi's own a0); lead to confirm.
Q6/Q7 not coded: Gate B is closed (lead, 23 Oct), so the no-launch-while-Gate-B-pending rule and Gate B's remaining-need reserve are not in budget.py. KITS_GLOB still reads gate-b-olmo* caps.

Reference pods (Q11): import-reference loads Gate B's plan.json reference for the arm pods. The B10 certification pod's reference (for reference pods) is not built in plan_tool; orchestrate (the runner builder) needs it.
Steps come from REV4 §1.1's dose table (33/38), not from the engine's stream plan on the edit's counts as in GBK. The runner or engine should check the steps against the edit file.

Not in BUILD-CORE, left for the runner builder, so these §7 items were NOT tested here: orchestrate, job runner commands J1-J18 (W1-18 --device cuda and --guard-batch-size; CLI argparse checks), preflight O500 projection, pack_setup per engine (the Y pack against YHASH), download (base at revision a1847dff, never main), the V/V' check, the cost-stage ledger (FR-10; transform seconds), the regeneration acceptance (a refused J2 holds J3 not_started, reason LS-04), the judge wrapper for B10 units, backup records, README.
LN-15e (A1 re-score, V2a) has no job kind (no code exists; fallback FO-04 as the limit). Stages 1b/1c are out of scope (Q18).
